question: What will Ryzen-KVM-1GB (India) cost in the cart when WebHorizon restocks it?
why: The order portal (clients.webhorizon.net) lists every India Ryzen plan, including the 1 GB entry plan, as 'Out of stock' on 2026-11-07 and prints no per-plan price on that page; only the line-level 'From $3.00 USD' is published. The per-plan cart price is unverified until a plan is orderable.
